snippet.title: 🧩 We’re reaching the beta phase of our card game developed #cardgame #gaming #mobilegame
snippet.description:
We’re getting close to launching the beta version of our collectible card game!
Our focus: battles that are fast, fluid, and cinematic, stepping beyond the classic “cards hitting each other” style with dynamic camera scenes that bring every fight to life.

Your feedback means a lot as we approach launch. Drop your thoughts in the comments and let us know what you think! 💬

👉 Check it out / wishlist on Steam: LUTA | Luminoria Tactics
 
Steam Store
